source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved Server Mgmt firmware controls persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults without disrupting BMC communication, event reporting, watchdog/recovery behavior, host boot or the independent management path needed to recover the server.
original_method: Manually change a bounded set of Server Mgmt controls, save/reboot and visually confirm persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while checking BMC, host and management health.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret and operate the pre-OS Server Mgmt page, approve controls that may affect BMC/watchdog/event behavior, perform both reboot phases and visually verify the exact firmware values. Agent checks are collateral evidence.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identities and management network topology
Exact Server Mgmt fields, dependencies and reset behavior
Approved baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Management, watchdog, event and recovery expectations
Independent local/serial console or alternate recovery path
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; change only named controls with documented host/BMC effects.
Do not modify the sole management or recovery path without an independent console and rollback method.
Do not enable watchdog/reset behavior without bounded timeout, monitoring and recovery ownership.
Stop on BMC reachability loss, unexpected reset, event-path loss, boot failure or configuration drift.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BIOS/BMC identity, reachability, sensor/event, host boot, OS log and management-service evidence.
Compare state against the approved field/dependency matrix after operator phases.
Do not drive BIOS, change BMC/network/watchdog policy or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields, values, defaults, side effects and independent recovery.
Perform/capture the persistence and default-restoration phases.
Assess management/host evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote agent operation. No source command exists; BMC API or OS management commands cannot substitute for the firmware page values under test.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware workflow and add read-only management checks through an independent path. Do not use BMC configuration writes as an equivalent unless the source explicitly defines shared ownership.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random is source wording only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each approved BIOS control, document its BMC/host/watchdog/event/network dependency, capture independent reachability and health before/after persistence/defaults, and prove the recovery path remains usable.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board, BIOS, BMC firmware and management topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, management protocol/client, OS and log-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Server Mgmt BIOS field documentation and BMC interface/recovery guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Bounds broad management changes and adds independent-path verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; retains firmware lifecycle and adds management and recovery evidence per field.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field dependencies, defaults, topology and alternate recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful BMC ping alone does not prove event, watchdog, sensor or host-interface behavior.

project_override_considerations: The project may approve only non-disruptive Server Mgmt fields and exclude watchdog or network changes. Results must name the tested subset and cannot imply coverage of excluded management functions.
expected_evidence: Platform/topology identity, field/dependency matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline BIOS/BMC values, management reachability, sensors/events and host health
Non-default captures, persistence and per-field management effects
Default captures, SPEC comparison and host/BMC/recovery health
Final configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The generic persistence/default lifecycle is coherent for mutable Server Mgmt fields. The broad title and missing values require a bounded project matrix but do not oppose the criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The lifecycle intent is clear. Exact fields and an independent recovery path are execution gates, not an unresolvable operation semantic.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with the manual boundary and adds management-specific dependency/recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its management/health evidence and bounded matrix while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates core firmware acceptance from automation and protects the recovery channel potentially changed by this same menu.

review_improvement: Makes management reachability, watchdog/reset behavior and independent recovery explicit instead of treating Server Mgmt as a generic settings page.
independent_technical_reasoning: The defining operations and acceptance are manual BIOS navigation and visual inspection. Automated BMC/OS health collection verifies consequences but not the core firmware state, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat management-setting changes or reboots after BMC, watchdog, event, boot or console anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
